Results.ReviewText:
I just bought my new Weber Sprit II and is taking about 20 - 30 minutes to reach 350 degrees and longer to reach 400 degrees but won't go over that. All the reviews and videos I watch advertised that it can reach 500 degrees in 15 minutes. 

Another thing if you finally reach over 350 degrees and open de lit you would have to wait again another 15 - 20 minutes to reach temperatures over 350 degrees.

I don't have any gas leaks and this is a new grill! I think I would have to return it, I'm very disappointed. The only reason I give it 3 starts is because the quality and look are really good.
Results.Title: Temperature won't even reach 400 degrees

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is one of your basic two burner grills. This is the first time I have a purchased a Weber product in several years, due primarily to the prices being the highest in the field. I am very pleased with this purchase and plan on keeping this grill for many years. It is very efficient and I had only one incident where it seemed to be running low on fuel, due to the temperature not getting as high as soon as normal. After turning it off and back on a couple of times, it started performing better. The only suggestion I have is to make the drip grease and water residue pans a little deeper. Even cooking for two people and a relatively small meal, with one side, the pan rsidue pan fills up close to the top, where it is hard to remove without partially spilling.
Results.Title: Years Since Owning Weber & Glad to Have Returned!

Results.ReviewText: Picked up my new Weber Spirit II E-210 grill yesterday.  Assemble was easy with by following the instructions, and the quality of the parts was evident from the very beginning.  Almost everything was powder coated, so there were very few sharp edges, so no cuts putting together.  It lights easy, and heats quickly.  The screws and small parts were packed in number coded bags, which were referred to in the instructions.  The grill parts were not marked, so it took some effort to find the right part amongst the packing, and it's well packed, lots of stuff for recycling.  Looking forward to many years of grilling.
Results.Title: Quality

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
